meta.race: Summer Recomp Block — Jun–Aug 2026 (Spartan Super 10K complete, May 31 2026)

calf_rules: Calf is mostly good post-race — explosive/impact work ramps gradually, gated on the calf reading.
No running or jumping in the early weeks. Conditioning stays calf-safe first (row, bike, swings, carries, sled).
Pain above 2/10 — back off immediately. Soreness lasting >24h after a new stimulus — repeat, don't advance.
Day 4 impact element (box step-off → run intervals) returns only if calf was ≤1/10 through the prior week. Any flare → pull it back out.
